headline: Q2FY27 Result Update

highlights: Risks: Intensifying competition, supply chain disruptions, and domestic slowdown, which could result in margin pressure V-Mart Retail reported healthy Q2FY27 revenue growth of 18% YoY to INR 953.0 Cr (vs INR 806.9 Cr), supported by store expansion and strong customer footfalls.
EBITDA increased 20% YoY to INR 86.1 Cr (vs INR 71.5 Cr), with margins improving to 9.0% (vs 8.9%).
Segment-wise, V-Mart format revenue grew 17% YoY to INR 775.0 Cr, while Unlimited grew 25% YoY to INR 172.1 Cr.
Revenue mix remained stable, with Apparel contributing 77%, Non-Apparel 10%, and FMCG 13%.
valuation: Festive-adjusted SSSG stood at 11% against reported growth of 3%. • Store Expansion: Management reiterated its target of opening 90–100 new stores in FY27, with 38 stores opened in H1FY27.
